Game Overview

In Space Builder Defender, the core idea is straightforward: defend humanity's last hope in space by constructing and upgrading outposts against relentless alien attacks. Gather resources wisely, build strategic defenses, and face increasingly challenging enemy waves. Survive amidst a cosmic battlefield where timely decisions and resourceful upgrading determine the fate of human expansion.
